**Role:** <!-- curator, or contributor/<domain>/<project>. Every session posts as the same
account, so this line is the only thing that says who is speaking. -->

## What is blocked

<!-- Concretely, with the path, branch or command. Not "the audit is strict" but "I cannot
add `gui_shim.cpp` because `.cpp` is not a registered kind". -->

## Which rule or check stands in the way

<!-- Name it: the article, the duty, the module. If you are not sure which, say what the
error was, verbatim. -->

## What you tried, and why you rejected it

<!-- The workarounds you considered and did not take. This is the most useful section: it
saves the curator re-deriving what you already ruled out, and it shows the rule was
respected rather than routed around. -->

## What you propose

<!-- A change, as specific as you can make it. "Register `.cpp` in `kinds.nim` with `//`
comments" beats "allow C++". If you cannot see a fix, say so; naming the problem is enough. -->

## What it costs to decline

<!-- What you will do instead, and what is lost. If the honest answer is "nothing much, I
can wait", say that too. A curator weighing this needs to know when it is not urgent. -->
